data.corpus_key: Colour Out of Space ~ Disintegrating Touch
data.description: A colour's touch causes a terrible disintegration of flesh and bone. A successful DC %1 Fortitude save halves the damage caused by a colour out of space's touch attack. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by a colour out of space's touch attack must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude save or be immediately slain and reduced to a pile of fine ash.
data.name: Disintegrating Touch
